G0191.kjv: give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand
senses: to hear, listen, attend, perceive by hearing, comprehend by hearing.

Intrans.: [[r:MRK.4.3|Mrk 4:3 7:37]], [[r:JAS.2.5|Jas 2:5]], [[r:REV.2.7|Rev 2:7]], al.; τ. ὠσίν, [[r:MAT.13.15|Mat 13:15]] (LXX); with cogn. dative, ακοῇ ἀ. (see: ἀκοή), [[r:MAT.13.14|Mat 13:14]], [[r:ACT.28.26|Act 28:26]]" (LXX); ὁ ἔχων ὦτα (οὖς) ἀκούειν, ἀκουσάτω, [[r:MAT.11.15|Mat 11:15]], [[r:MRK.4.23|Mrk 4:23]], [[r:REV.2.7|Rev 2:7]], al.

Trans., prop. with accusative of thing(s), of thing heard, genitive of person(s), from whom heard (LS, see word): [[r:ACT.1.4|Act 1:4]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.12.19|Mat 12:19]], [[r:JHN.3.8|Jhn 3:8]] (Abbott, JG, 76), [[r:ACT.22.9|Act 22:9]], al.; with dupl. accusative, [[r:JHN.12.18|Jhn 12:18]], [[r:1CO.11.18|1Co 11:18]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:JHN.7.40|Jhn 7:40]] (Abbott, JV, 116); τ. φωνῆς (cf. Heb. שָׁמַע בְּקוֹל, [[r:EXO.18.19|Exo 18:19]]), [[r:JHN.5.25|Jhn 5:25, 28]] [[r:ACT.9.7|Act 9:7]] (on the distinction bet. this and ἀ. φωνήν, ib. 4, see M, Pr., 66; Field, Notes, 117; Abbott, Essays, 93f.); of God answering prayer, [[r:JHN.9.31|Jhn 9:31]], [[r:1JN.5.14|1Jn 5:14]], 15; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, [[r:JHN.8.26|Jhn 8:26, 40]] [[r:ACT.10.22|Act 10:22]], [[r:2TI.2.2|2Ti 2:2]]; id. before ἀπό, [[r:1JN.1.5|1Jn 1:5]]; with genitive pars. before ptcp., [[r:MRK.14.58|Mrk 14:58]], [[r:LUK.18.36|Luk 18:36]], al. (On NT usage generally, see Bl., §36, 5; Cremer, 82.) (AS)
(ἀκριβής), to enquire with exactness, learn carefully: [[r:MAT.2.7|Mat 2:7, 16]] (for similar ex., see MM, VGT, sv.).† (AS)

ἀκριβῶς adv. (ἀκριβής), with exactness, carefully: [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8]], [[r:LUK.1.3|Luk 1:3]], [[r:ACT.18.25|Act 18:25]], [[r:EPH.5.15|Eph 5:15]], [[r:1TH.5.2|1Th 5:2]] (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), [[r:ACT.18.26|Act 18:26 23:15, 20 24:22]].† (AS)

G0125.strongs: Ægyptus, the land of the Nile
senses: Egypt: [[r:MAT.2.13|Mat 2:13-15,19]], [[r:ACT.2.10|Act 2:10 7:9-39]], [[r:HEB.3.16|Heb 3:16 11:26,27]]; γῆ Αἴ., [[r:ACT.7.40|Act 7:40 13:17]], [[r:HEB.8.9|Heb 8:9]], Ju 5 (cf. [[r:EXO.5.12|Exo 5:12]], al.); ἡ Αἴ., [[r:ACT.7.11|Act 7:11]]; figuratively, of Jerusalem as hostile to God, [[r:REV.11.8|Rev 11:8.]]† (AS)

G0142.strongs: to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare) to expiate sin
G0142.kjv: away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up)
senses: to raise, take up, lift or draw up: [[r:JHN.8.59|Jhn 8:59 11:41]], [[r:ACT.27.17|Act 27:17]], al.

to bear or take away, carry off, remove: [[r:MAT.21.21|Mat 21:21]], [[r:JHN.19.31|Jhn 19:31]], [[r:1CO.5.12|1Co 5:12 6:15]] (see Lft., Notes, 216), al.; of the taking away sin by Christ, [[r:JHN.1.29|Jhn 1:29]], [[r:1JN.3.5|1Jn 3:5]]. (Cf. ἀπ᾽, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, μετ-, συν-, ὑπερ-αίρω). For exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0190.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a particle of union) and κέλευθος (a road)
G0190.strongs: properly, to be in the same way with, i.e. to accompany (specially, as a disciple)
senses: (ἀκόλουθος, following; ἀ- cop., κέλευθος, poët., away), to accompany, follow: [[r:MAT.4.25|Mat 4:25]], al. Metaphorical, of discipleship: [[r:MAT.9.9|Mat 9:9]], [[r:MRK.9.38|Mrk 9:38]], [[r:JHN.12.26|Jhn 12:26]], al. Absol.: [[r:MAT.18.10|Mat 18:10]]; more freq., with dative (cl.), [[r:MAT.8.1|Mat 8:1]], al.; before μετά, with genitive, (cl.; Eutherford, N.Phr., 458 f.), [[r:LUK.9.49|Luk 9:49]]; ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אָהֲרֵי), [[r:MAT.10.38|Mat 10:38]] (cf. ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, παρ-, συν-ἀκολουθέω). SYN.: (cl.) ἕπομαι, not in NT (see Cremer, 80; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

G0189.strongs: hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard)
G0189.kjv: audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor
senses: hearing, the sense of hearing: [[r:1CO.12.17|1Co 12:17]], [[r:2PE.2.8|2Pe 2:8]]; "Hebraic dative," ἀκοῇ ακούειν (frequently in LXX; V. M, Pr., 14, 75), [[r:MAT.13.14|Mat 13:14]], [[r:ACT.28.26|Act 28:26]].
organ of hearing, the ear (Arist., al.; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:2TI.4.3|2Ti 4:3-4]]; pl., [[r:MRK.7.35|Mrk 7:35]], [[r:LUK.7.1|Luk 7:1]], [[r:ACT.17.20|Act 17:20]], [[r:HEB.5.11|Heb 5:11]].
a message, teaching: [[r:JHN.12.38|Jhn 12:38]] and [[r:ROM.16.16|Rom 16:16,17]]" (LXX), [[r:GAL.3.2|Gal 3:2]],5 R, mg.; λόγος ἀκοῆς, [[r:1TH.2.13|1Th 2:13]], [[r:HEB.4.2|Heb 4:2]];
a report, rumour: with genitive, of person(s), [[r:MAT.4.24|Mat 4:24, 14:1, 24:6]]; [[r:MRK.1.28|Mrk 1:28 13:7]] (Cremer, 82, 623; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0154.kjv: ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require
senses: to ask, request: absol., [[r:MAT.7.7|Mat 7:7]], [[r:JAS.1.6|Jas 1:6]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.5.42|Mat 5:42]], [[r:LUK.6.30|Luk 6:30]]; with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.20.20|Mat 20:20]], [[r:1JN.5.15|1Jn 5:15]]; id. before παρά, [[r:ACT.3.2|Act 3:2]], [[r:JAS.1.5|Jas 1:5]]; with dupl. accusative [[r:MAT.7.9|Mat 7:9]], [[r:MRK.6.22|Mrk 6:22]], [[r:JHN.16.23|Jhn 16:23]]. Mid. (on the distinction bet. mid. and act., see M, Pr., 160): absol., [[r:MRK.15.8|Mrk 15:8]], [[r:JHN.16.26|Jhn 16:26]], [[r:JAS.4.3|Jas 4:3]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.14.7|Mat 14:7]], [[r:MRK.6.24|Mrk 6:24]], al.; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.27.20|Mat 27:20]], [[r:LUK.23.25|Luk 23:25]]; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, [[r:ACT.9.2|Act 9:2]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:LUK.23.23|Luk 23:23.]] with inf. [[r:ACT.7.46|Act 7:46]], [[r:EPH.3.13|Eph 3:13]] (cf. ἀπ-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, παρ-, προσ- αιτέω). SYN.: ἐρωτάω, which see, πυνθάνομαι. On the proper distinction between these words, see Tr., Syn., § xl, Thayer, see word αἰ. In late Gk., however, αἰ. and ἐ. seem to have become practically synonymous (cf. [[r:ACT.3.2|Act 3:2]],3; see Field, Notes, 101 f.; M, Th., I, 4:1; M, Pr., 66.n; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

(ἀκή, a point), a prickly plant, thorn, brier; in NT always pl.: [[r:MAT.7.16|Mat 7:16 13:7,22 27:29]], [[r:MRK.4.7|Mrk 4:7,18]], [[r:LUK.6.44|Luk 6:44 8:7,14]], [[r:JHN.19.2|Jhn 19:2]], [[r:HEB.6.8|Heb 6:8]] (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0131.strongs: to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage
G0131.kjv: diseased with an issue of blood
senses: (αἷμα, ῥέω), to lose blood, suffer from a flow of blood (Hipp.): [[r:MAT.9.20|Mat 9:20.]]† (AS)

G0169.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G2508]] (meaning cleansed)

G0185.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G2767]]
senses: (κεράννυμι), unmixed, pure, hence, metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), guileless, simple: [[r:MAT.10.16|Mat 10:16]], [[r:ROM.16.19|Rom 16:19]], [[r:PHP.2.15|Php 2:15]].† SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς (cf. Ellic. on Phl., l.with; Tr., Syn., §lvi). (AS)

G0165.strongs: properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future)
G0165.kjv: age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the, while the) world (began, without end)
senses: in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT);
of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), [[r:LUK.1.70|Luk 1:70]];

of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, [[r:MAT.21.19|Mat 21:19]]; id., with neg., never, [[r:JHN.4.14|Jhn 4:14]]; more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., [[r:HEB.1.8|Heb 1:8]] (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., [[r:MAT.6.13|Mat 6:13]]; εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. [[r:ISA.45.17|Isa 45:17]], עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), [[r:ROM.16.27|Rom 16:27]], LT; cf. also [[r:EPH.3.21|Eph 3:21]], [[r:2PE.3.18|2Pe 3:18]], Ju 25, [[r:REV.14.11|Rev 14:11]].

οἱ αἰ., the worlds, the universe, "the sum of the periods of time, including all that is manifested in them": He:12 11:3 (cf. [[r:1TI.1.17|1Ti 1:17]], where τῶν αἰ. are prob. "the ages or world-periods which when summed up make eternity".

the present age (Heb. הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה): ὁ αἰ., [[r:MAT.13.22|Mat 13:22]]; ὁ αἰ. οὗτος, [[r:MAT.12.32|Mat 12:32]]; ὁ νῦν αἰ., [[r:1TI.6.17|1Ti 6:17]]; ὁ ἐνεστὼς αἰ., [[r:GAL.1.4|Gal 1:4]]; similarly, of the time after Christ's second coming (הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא), ὁ αἰ. ἐκεῖνος, [[r:LUK.20.35|Luk 20:35]]; ὁ αἰ. μέλλων, [[r:MAT.12.32|Mat 12:32]]; ὁ αἰ. ὁ ἐρχόμενος, [[r:MRK.10.30|Mrk 10:30.]] SYN.: κόσμος, the ordered universe, the scheme of material things; οἰκουμένη, the inhabited earth; in contrast with both of which αἰ. is the world under aspects of time (cf. Westc. on [[r:HEB.1.2|Heb 1:2]]; Tr., Syn., §lix; Thayer, see word, αἰ.; Cremer, 74, 620; MM, VGT). (AS)

G0123.forms: αἰγιαλός, -οῦ, ὁ (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word)

G0123.strongs: a beach (on which the waves dash)
senses: the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:MAT.13.2|Mat 13:2,48]] [[r:JHN.21.4|Jhn 21:4]], [[r:ACT.21.5|Act 21:5 27:39,40]].† (AS)

G0188.root: accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to ἀκή (a point) and meaning the same
senses: a point, used as adv., at the present point of time, even now, even yet: [[r:MAT.15.16|Mat 15:16.]]† (AS)

G0129.strongs: blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred
senses: of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): [[r:JHN.1.13|Jhn 1:13]] (see MM, VGT, see word);

as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: [[r:MAT.16.17|Mat 16:17]], [[r:1CO.15.50|1Co 15:50]], [[r:GAL.1.16|Gal 1:16]], [[r:EPH.6.12|Eph 6:12]], [[r:HEB.2.14|Heb 2:14]]; (with) of things in colour resembling blood: [[r:ACT.2.19|Act 2:19,20]], [[r:REV.6.12|Rev 6:12 14:18-20]].
Abbott-Smith omits this number to be unable (cl., Philo; π., see MM, VGT, see word).
In LXX and NT (Kennedy, Sources, 124; Hatch, Essays, 4; Field, Notes, 46 f.), to be impossible: [[r:MAT.17.20|Mat 17:20]], [[r:LUK.1.37|Luk 1:37]]. † (AS)

G0166.strongs: perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well)
senses: of that which is without either beginning or end: [[r:ROM.16.26|Rom 16:26]], [[r:HEB.9.14|Heb 9:14]];

of that which is without beginning: [[r:ROM.16.25|Rom 16:25]], [[r:2TI.1.9|2Ti 1:9]], [[r:TIT.1.2|Tit 1:2]]; (with) of that which is without end (MM, VGT, see word): σκηναί, [[r:LUK.16.9|Luk 16:9]] οἰκία, [[r:2CO.5.1|2Co 5:1]]; διαθήκη, [[r:HEB.13.20|Heb 13:20]]; εὐαγγέλιον, [[r:REV.14.6|Rev 14:6]]; παράκλησις, [[r:2TH.2.16|2Th 2:16]]; λύτρωσις, [[r:HEB.9.12|Heb 9:12]]; κληρονομία, ib. 15; κόλασις, [[r:MAT.25.46|Mat 25:46]]; κρίμα, [[r:HEB.6.2|Heb 6:2]]; κρίσις, [[r:MRK.3.29|Mrk 3:29]]; ὄλεθρον, [[r:2TH.1.9|2Th 1:9]]; πῦρ, [[r:MAT.18.8|Mat 18:8]]; frequently with ζωή, which see SYN.: ἀΐδιος, which see (AS)

G0156.strongs: a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved)
senses: cause, reason, occasion, case: [[r:MAT.19.3|Mat 19:3]], [[r:LUK.8.47|Luk 8:47]], [[r:ACT.10.21|Act 10:21 22:24 28:20]], [[r:2TI.1.6|2Ti 1:6,12]], [[r:TIT.1.13|Tit 1:13]], [[r:HEB.2.11|Heb 2:11]]; εἰ οὕτως ἐστιν ἡ αἰ. (cf. Lat. si ita res se habet, and see MM. VGT, see word), [[r:MAT.19.10|Mat 19:10.]]

cause for punishment, crime: [[r:MAT.27.37|Mat 27:37]], [[r:MRK.15.26|Mrk 15:26]], [[r:JHN.18.38|Jhn 18:38 19:4,6]], [[r:ACT.13.28|Act 13:28 23:28 28:18]]. † SYN.: ἔλεγχος, a charge, whether moral or judicial, which has been proven, αἰ. is an accusation simply, false or true. (AS)

G0102.strongs: unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible
G0102.kjv: could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak
senses: of persons, unable, powerless: [[r:ACT.14.8|Act 14:8]]; figuratively [[r:ROM.15.1|Rom 15:1]] (MM, VGT, see word).

G0136.strongs: properly, a story, but used in the sense of; praise (of God)

senses: (ἀκρατής, which see), in Arist. and later writers = ἀκράτεια (Lft., Notes, 222 f.), want of power, hence want of self-control, incontinence: [[r:MAT.23.25|Mat 23:25]], [[r:1CO.7.5|1Co 7:5]].† (AS)

an eagle: [[r:REV.4.7|Rev 4:7 8:13]] (Rec. ἀγγέλου) 12:14. Where carrion is referred to, ἀ. is probably a vulture (cf. [[r:JOB.39.30|Job 39:30]], [[r:PRO.30.17|Pro 30:17]]): [[r:MAT.24.28|Mat 24:28]], [[r:LUK.17.37|Luk 17:37]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0106.strongs: unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week
senses: (ζύμη), unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., [[r:MRK.14.1|Mrk 14:1]]), [[r:LUK.22.1|Luk 22:1]]; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., [[r:MAT.26.17|Mat 26:17]], [[r:MRK.14.12|Mrk 14:12]], [[r:LUK.22.7|Luk 22:7]]; ἡμέραι, [[r:ACT.12.3|Act 12:3 20:6]]. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: [[r:1CO.5.7|1Co 5:7]]; exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), ib. 8 (Cremer, 724).† (AS)

G0121.forms: ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, see word; Mayser, 131), -ον
G0121.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of [[w:G5087]] (meaning a penalty)

G0114.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G5087]]
G0114.strongs: to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate
G0114.kjv: cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject
senses: to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην , [[r:GAL.3.16|Gal 3:16]]; ἐντολήν , [[r:MRK.7.9|Mrk 7:9]]; νόμον . [[r:HEB.10.28|Heb 10:28]]; πίστιν , [[r:1TI.5.12|1Ti 5:12.]]
to reject: [[r:MRK.6.26|Mrk 6:26]] (Field, op. cit., 30), [[r:LUK.10.16|Lk 10:16]], [[r:JHN.12.48|Jhn 12:48]], I Th 48, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
of acantha-wood (Hdt.; π. ap. MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0134.forms: αἰνέω, -ῶ (αἶνος), poët., Ion. and late prose (MM, VGT, see word) for cl. ἐπαινέω
senses: to praise: with accusative, τ. θεόν, [[r:LUK.2.13|Luk 2:13,20 19:37 24:53]], [[r:ACT.2.47|Act 2:47 3:8,9]], [[r:ROM.15.11|Rom 15:11]]; with dative, τ. Θεῷ ([[r:JER.20.13|Jer 20:13]], al. for הִלֵּל לְ; see Field, Notes, 245), [[r:REV.19.5|Rev 19:5.]]† SYN.: ἐξομολογέω, εὐλογέω, εὐχαριστέω, μακαρίζω (see DCG, i, 211). (AS)

G0164.root: from αἰχμή (a spear) and a derivative of the same as [[w:G0259]]
G0164.strongs: properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive

senses: to perceive: withaccusative of thing(s) (Bl., §36, 5; MM, VGT, see word), [[r:LUK.9.45|Luk 9:45]] (Cremer, 619 f.).† (AS)

(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), shame (MM, VGT, see word): subjectively, [[r:LUK.14.19|Luk 14:19]], [[r:2CO.4.2|2Co 4:2]]; objectively, [[r:PHP.3.19|Php 3:19]], [[r:HEB.12.2|Heb 12:2]]; as something to be ashamed of, [[r:REV.3.18|Rev 3:18]]; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), shameful deeds, Ju 13.† SYN.: αἰδώς, which see (AS)

to make ashamed ([[r:SIR.13.7|Sir 13:7]]). Pass., to be put to shame, be ashamed: [[r:2CO.10.8|2Co 10:8]]; [[r:PHP.1.20|Php 1:20]], [[r:1PE.4.16|1Pe 4:16]], [[r:1JN.2.28|1Jn 2:28]]; with inf. (M, Pr., 205), [[r:LUK.16.3|Luk 16:3]] (cf. ἐπ- (-ομαι), κατ- αἰσχύνω). † (AS)

instability (MM, VGT, see word); hence, confusion, tumult: [[r:1CO.14.33|1Co 14:33]], [[r:JAS.3.16|Jas 3:16]]; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), [[r:LUK.21.9|Luk 21:9]], [[r:2CO.6.5|2Co 6:5, 12:20]] (Polyb., al.; see Cremer, 739).† (AS)

G0163.kjv: lead away captive, bring into captivity
senses: (αἰχμάλωτος), in late writers = cl. αἰχμάλωτον ποιῶ (ἄγω), to take or lead captive: before εἰς, [[r:LUK.21.24|Luk 21:24]] (cf. [[r:TOB.1.10|Tob 1:10]]); metaphorically, [[r:ROM.7.23|Rom 7:23]], [[r:2CO.10.5|2Co 10:5]], [[r:2TI.3.6|2Ti 3:6]].† (AS)

G0160.forms: αἰφνίδιος (in Lk, l.with, ἐφν- WH; see M, Pr., 35), -ον
G0160.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and [[w:G5316]] (compare [[w:G1810]]) (meaning non-apparent)

senses: causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: [[r:HEB.5.9|Heb 5:9]]; τὸ αἰ., the cause, [[r:ACT.19.40|Act 19:40.]]
blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, [[r:LUK.23.4|Luk 23:4,14,22]]. † (AS)

G0155.strongs: a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking
senses: (αἰτέω), that which has been asked for, a petition, request: [[r:LUK.23.24|Luk 23:24]], [[r:PHP.4.6|Php 4:6]], [[r:JHN.5.15|Jhn 5:15]].† SYN.: see: δέησις. (AS)

G0137.forms: Αἰνών, ἡ, indecl. (cf. Heb.עַיִן, a spring)
G0137.root: of Hebrew origin (a derivative of [[w:G5869]], place of springs)

G0184.root: of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood
G0184.strongs: corresponding to and); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem
senses: § Akeldama dama (Proper name) (traditionally located south of the valley of Hinnom), "field of blood"
